youtube_short.title: Your Emotions Are Stealing $14,000 From You
title_alternatives: 90% of Your Purchases Aren't Logical — Here's Why
The Emotional Spending Trap That Costs $14K/Year
youtube_short.description: Scientists say 90% of purchases are emotional, not logical — and retailers spend $18 billion a year studying your triggers. Stress, celebration, boredom: every emotional state has a spending cost attached to it, and they know exactly when to hit you. The fix is a simple 24-hour pause before any unplanned purchase — one rule that saves the average emotional spender $14,000 a year. Save this before your next shopping session. #moneypsychology #personalfinance #financetips #emotionalspending #savemoney
